principle: D and E may differ in silhouette, energy and ribbon geometry, but they must obey one shared anatomical grammar. A state may hide or reveal an existing limb; it must not invent a limb.

shared_base_anatomy.face: 1 shared face/head region integrated into abstract ribbon body
shared_base_anatomy.note: Arms/hands may be fully or partly occluded behind ribbon/body forms in neutral and low-energy states.

D_Knot.limb_style: short soft arms/hands; gestures stay close to body

E_Tilt.limb_style: same two-arm/two-hand grammar; gestures can open farther from body

invariants: Both characters possess the same limb count in the rig.
No state may add legs or feet in V1.
No state may add a third arm/hand or remove an anatomical side; occlusion is allowed.
A hand may be hidden behind the body/ribbon, but its rig slot still exists.
Left/right naming and pivots must be stable across every state.
Character-specific silhouette differences come from ribbon geometry and motion language, not incompatible anatomy.

IDLE.arms_hands: both present; relaxed/tucked; partial occlusion allowed

LISTEN.arms_hands: both present; low-motion attentive pose; partial occlusion allowed

THINK.arms_hands: both present; one or both may support face/body; never newly spawned

SPEAK.arms_hands: both present; one may gesture while the other remains tucked

SUCCESS.arms_hands: both present; wider positive gesture allowed

GREETING_LATER.arms_hands: both present; one-hand wave allowed, other hand remains anatomically accounted for

rig_layer_requirement.note: A generic single gesture_foreground layer is insufficient as final anatomy because it cannot guarantee stable two-arm/two-hand continuity.

neutral_master_policy.core_identity_authority: existing D/E locked masters + Founder reference set
neutral_master_policy.anatomy_note: Existing flattened masters remain core face/ribbon identity authority. Rig authoring may introduce hidden/tucked two-arm anatomy where founder references demonstrate limbs, provided neutral recomposition preserves the visible master silhouette at app size.

future_upgrade_rule: If legs/feet become a real product need, open a versioned anatomy change for BOTH D and E, update both rigs, state matrix, fallback assets and device QA together.
